principle: One new idea at a time. Same rules as the real game.

steps.title: Play a Friend
steps.instruction: Pick a card, then pick a glowing tile.
steps.success: You put a creature into the world.

steps.title: Shape the World
steps.instruction: Choose an element, then shape a glowing tile.

steps.title: Move
steps.instruction: Pick your creature, then an adjacent tile.

steps.title: Know When to Pass
steps.instruction: Pass when you want to save cards for the next Chapter.
steps.success: Win 2 Chapters to win the match.

steps.title: Make Magic Mix
steps.instruction: Put two elemental states on the same tile.
steps.success: The tile transforms and enters your Codex.

steps.title: Your Commander
steps.instruction: Use your Command once each Chapter.
steps.success: Your Commander helps define your deck.
